hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env.example|*/.env.example) ;; *.env|*/.env|*/.env.*|.env.*|secrets.toml|*/secrets.toml|uv.lock|*/uv.lock) echo 'Blocked: edit .env/.env.* via your editor; regenerate uv.lock with uv lock; secrets.toml is off-limits. (Guards Edit/Write/MultiEdit only, not Bash — this is an accident guardrail, not a security boundary.)' >&2; exit 2;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py|*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; rc=0; case "$f" in *.py) o=$(uv run ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'ruff check: %s\n' "${o:-failed with no output}" >&2; rc=2; };; esac; o=$(uv run ruff format "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'ruff format: %s\n' "${o:-failed with no output}" >&2; rc=2; }; exit $rc
